WPSS No.1649 of 2026
Rakesh Mohan ……….Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand 
and others …….Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned Addl. C.S.C. for 
the State.
3. Mr. Pankaj Miglani, learned counsel for the 
respondent no.3, through video conferencing.
4. Petitioner has filed the present writ petition 
seeking a writ of mandamus commanding the 
respondents to promote the petitioner to the post of 
Assistant Engineer under Degree holder quota, after 
excluding respondent no.4 from the zone of 
consideration.
5. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that respondent no.4 was inducted within 
the zone of consideration from the respondents in 
order to give him undue benefit while he is not a 
Junior Engineer holding a Degree of Bachelor of 
Engineering/B.Tech.
6. He further explains that respondent no.2 has 
got the degree from the Institution of Civil 
Engineering (India), Ludhiana which according to 
learned counsel for the petitioner has been declared 
to be invalid by this Court.
7. The contention raised by learned counsel for 
the petitioner appears to be palpable, in view of the  fact that he is a degree holder from an institution 
which is not found valid.
8. Learned counsel for the respondent(s) shall get 
instructions within 48 hours.
9. List this case on 08.07.2026.
10. In the meantime, the result of D.P.C. held on 
25.06.2026 in respect of the Degree Holder Quota be 
not declared.
11. Learned counsel for the State shall 
communicate this order to the respondents today 
itself.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 06.07.2026
SK

4. Counter affidavit filed by respondent no.3 is taken on 
record.
Modification Application (IA No.2 of 2026)
5. A modification application has been filed by the 
respondent-Commission for modifying the order dated 
06.07.2026, passed by this Court whereby respondent 
was directed not to open result of the DPC.
6. The Commission has forwarded the recommendation 
of the DPC to the State Government on 30.06.2026 to the 
State Government and for that reason the modification 
application has been filed.
7. There is no point in moving the modification 
application as the interim order is for not to declare result 
of DPC by the respondents.
8. Accordingly modification application being 
misconceived, stands rejected.
WPSS No.1649 of 2026
9. Learned counsel for the State prays for and is  2
granted four weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
10. List this case on 08.12.2026.
11. Interim order dated 06.07.2026 is extended till the 
next date of listing.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
